title: Prefill: indexer logits + exact top-k
shape: NVFP4 1-node DEP16 slice (L24 view: 18 KDA + 6 DSA + 23 MoE layers), F16K at L78K, ms per forward
basis: MEASURED 1-GPU microbench at the deployed per-GPU shape (stock: runs/P-IDX/two12.log stock line, 2.22-2.24 ms/layer x24); new path not yet faster, so current = stock
gap_analysis: Stock per DSA layer (1 GPU, 3 x 5461 rows @ 78360 keys): 2.22 ms = DeepGEMM sm100_mqa_logits 1.55 (1x-K MMA, BF16 logits to HBM) + trtllm_gvr2 0.65. Hardware floor at stock precision: the epilogue needs 16 cvt.rn.relu.bf16x2 + 16 fma.rn.bf16x2 + 2 add per (token, key) (34 instr, 1.24e9 pairs/layer) = 0.66 ms/layer at full issue, ~0.85 ms at a realistic 75%; the 2x-K FP4 MMA alone measured 0.54 ms/layer (1-CTA SS). The model prices idx_score as an FP32-SIMT epilogue (1.206 ms) + topk 0.188; stock math is packed BF16, so the model is pessimistic for the score (model error) but its total 1.39 ms/layer (33.5 ms) remains a valid target. New sm_107 path measured: score 2.28 ms (epilogue ~50 instr per (token, key) incl. TMEM ld, weight LDS, staging; ~45% issue efficiency because only 2 epilogue warps per SMSP are active per tile in the pair-alternating layout), select 0.96 ms (one 1024-thread CTA per row, latency-bound phases). A fused streaming exact select inside the epilogue was measured and rejected (5-10 ms: ~9.7K inserts and ~8 CTA-stalling compactions per token on iid logits).
inefficiencies: MEASURED: score epilogue issue-bound at ~45% efficiency (in-kernel clock64: per 4-token tile per warp: acc wait 133, TMEM ld+math 1028, staging 158, barrier 84 clk)
MEASURED: only 2 of 4 epilogue warps per SMSP active per tile (pair-alternating accumulator stages); register cap 96-112 limits more warps
MEASURED: PrefillSelect 0.96 ms: 16383 single-row 1024-thread CTAs, 1 CTA/SM, serial passes
MEASURED: in-epilogue streaming exact select too costly on iid logits (rejected)
MODEL ERROR: idx_score epilogue priced as FP32 SIMT; stock math is packed BF16
rubin_features: 2x-K block-scaled MMA (mxf4 K128) via sm_107a descriptors
oversized shared memory for per-row histograms
plan: Score: raise active epilogue warps per SMSP (6 epilogue WGs at <=78 regs, 1 token per TMEM load batch, weights from smem), keep MMA-row-order staging + bulk stores; target <= 1.0 ms/layer
Select: 2-4 rows per CTA (512-thread row groups) or a persistent multi-row select to overlap per-row latency; target <= 0.25 ms/layer

Then: wire into vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/dsa.py prefill (one score+select per layer instead of 12 chunks; K gathered 128-aligned), unit test vs stock (bitwise logits, exact top-k), step A/B with tools/step_p.sh
Model fix note: price idx_score epilogue as packed BF16 (34 instr per (token,key))

work.result: stock epilogue is packed BF16 (cvt relu bf16x2 + hfma2), logits BF16; 12 chunks/layer at 512 MB budget

work.what: Fused kernel v1 first run on VR200 (check + P3-16 perf)
work.result: logits bitwise equal to DeepGEMM on all valid elements (max 0 ulp), exact top-k on 859/859 test rows; 5.99 ms/layer (slow)

work.what: Stage split at P3-16 shape (bench modes)
work.result: MMA+TMA pipeline only 0.583 ms; + BF16 logits epilogue 1.382 ms (stock logits kernel 1.558 + writes); + streaming exact select 6.4 ms -> selection is the bottleneck

work.what: Selection fixes: key scales by one bulk copy (key rows in SF-atom order), weights in registers, fine (one bin per BF16 value) compaction histogram, rank tie cut, thresholds in smem
work.result: 5.15 ms/layer, still exact; instrumenting compaction counts/time (runs/P-IDX/fused9.log)

work.what: In-kernel stats (iid random logits): 11K inserts and ~9 compactions per token; each compaction stalls the CTA through the 2-stage accumulator ring
work.result: root cause of the slow select (compaction = several latency-bound passes with contended smem atomics)

work.what: Redesign: per-token histogram of buffered keys (one bin per BF16 value above a base) maintained by the token warp; threshold raised every tile by a warp scan (exact); compaction becomes one filter pass + rebase; ILP epilogue variant (both tokens loaded, early TMEM release)
work.result: first try hung (unbounded while loop in the DSL, step cancelled); bounded warp-scan version running (runs/P-IDX/fused11.log)

work.what: Pivot to two kernels: sm_107 IndexerScore writes BF16 logits (bitwise stock) + PrefillSelect (sdec IndexerSelect adapted, exact)
work.result: 899/899 rows exact; first perf: score 1.49 (uncoalesced stores) / select 0.96 ms

work.what: Store path experiments (natural order + scale transpose warp, per-warp 64 B bulk stores, MMA-row-order staging with warpgroup bulk stores, maxima in select) + in-kernel clock64 phase profile
work.result: MMA-only 0.54 ms; score 2.28 ms (epilogue issue-bound ~45%); select 0.96 ms; total 3.24 ms vs stock 2.22 -> not landable yet (runs/P-IDX/two12.log)
